title: Wear complication showing wrong BG value
body:

comments.body: I am working on this now.
This should be fixed in the 15th Jan nightly which is available now.
Which watch faces work with that?
@Thasgolas any supporting complication, look at skymaster for example.
@gregorybel isn't the -7.55 shown at the end part of the received status string?

No it is not part, this has been introduced since modificatios from yesterday.

and unfortunately, bg value is still wrong.
Please try the Jan 16th Nightly to resolve this issue. thanks
@jamorham yeah it yorks fine now, thanks a lot! Sorry, yesterday did not manage to test it.
